_comment: Merge the 'hooks' key into the user's existing ~/.claude/settings.json. Do not replace the file - it may already hold permissions, model, statusLine, and other settings. Use ONE of the two SessionStart entries below, matching the user's platform, and delete the other. Replace <ABSOLUTE-PATH> with a real absolute path: in exec form (when 'args' is present) there is no shell, so ~ and %USERPROFILE% are NOT expanded.

SessionStart._comment: macOS / Linux. Shell form: no 'args', so the command string is passed to sh -c.

Windows. Exec form: 'args' is present, so there is no shell, the path must be literal and absolute, and 'command' must be a real .exe. -ExecutionPolicy Bypass is required because the default policy blocks unsigned local scripts; -NoProfile stops a user profile from printing a banner that would corrupt the JSON payload.

PreToolUse._comment: Optional. Blocks writes to a protected path. Remove this block if the user did not ask for a write guard.
